    • maxUses

      public VillagerTradeProviderBase.VillagerTradeBuilder maxUses(int maxUses)
      Sets how often this trade can be used before the merchant runs out of stock. Defaults to 4.

    • xp

      public VillagerTradeProviderBase.VillagerTradeBuilder xp(int xp)
      Sets the merchant experience granted for using this trade. Defaults to 1.

    • reputationDiscount

      public VillagerTradeProviderBase.VillagerTradeBuilder reputationDiscount(float reputationDiscount)
      Sets the fraction of the price that is discounted per reputation point the player has with the merchant. Defaults to 0, vanilla villager trades commonly use 0.05.

      public VillagerTradeProviderBase.VillagerTradeBuilder merchantPredicate(net.minecraft.world.level.storage.loot.predicates.LootItemCondition condition)
      Sets a condition that is tested against the merchant. If it does not match, the trade is not offered.

    • merchantPredicate

      Sets a condition that is tested against the merchant. If it does not match, the trade is not offered.

      public VillagerTradeProviderBase.VillagerTradeBuilder modifyResult(net.minecraft.world.level.storage.loot.functions.LootItemFunction... modifiers)
      Adds loot functions that are applied to the given item stack when the trade is created. This can be used to randomise the result, for example to enchant it.

    • doublePriceFor

      public VillagerTradeProviderBase.VillagerTradeBuilder doublePriceFor(net.minecraft.tags.TagKey<net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.Enchantment> enchantments)
      Sets a set of enchantments that double the price of this trade when the result carries any of them as a stored enchantment. Used by vanilla for enchanted book trades.

    • doublePriceFor

      public VillagerTradeProviderBase.VillagerTradeBuilder doublePriceFor(net.minecraft.core.HolderSet<net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.Enchantment> enchantments)

    • build

      public net.minecraft.core.Holder<net.minecraft.world.item.trading.VillagerTrade> build()
      Builds the VillagerTrade. This method returns an intrusive holder that must be properly added to the registry. RegistryProviderBase does this automatically if the result is stored in a public, non-static field inside the provider.
